_comment: Starter Claude Code settings for a project. Copy to the project's .claude/settings.json and adjust. This is a TEMPLATE: it carries no secrets, no machine-specific paths, and no accumulated personal permission grants. Keep it that way — secrets belong in the environment or an encrypted store, never in a committed settings file.
_comment_permissions: deny always wins over allow. 'ask' prompts. Start strict and widen deliberately as the project needs it, rather than starting wide.
_comment_hooks: Editor-side hooks are separate from the git hooks in claude-baseline/hooks/. Wire git hooks with hooks/install.sh. The SessionStart briefing surfaces, in one block: unpushed/uncommitted work (all branches), the DEFERRED.md ledger (baseline Section 24), and any fleet drill drift. SessionEnd repeats the push check at close. All are fail-open and safe to keep.
_comment_env: Never put secret values here. This file is committed. Reference environment variables that are set outside the repo.
